en.html:
There is a popular story...

Sengo Muramasa and Gorou Masamune learned their craft under the same master. Both born talented. In temperament, opposite ends of the world.

One day the master made them forge a sword each, then stood the swords in a river.

Leaves drifted toward Muramasa's blade. It cut them.

Masamune's blade let them pass. No cutting.

—The finest blade cuts what should be cut, and leaves what should not be cut.

So the master said. The praise went to Masamune, not Muramasa.

............But one question remained.

Which of them had shown a weapon for what it really was? A blade, doing the actual business of a blade?

ja.html:
俗説に曰く……

　千子村正と五郎正宗は同じ師のもとで業を学んだ。
　共に天性の才を示したが、性質は全く逆であった。

　あるとき師は二人に刀を打たせ、それを川へ立てた。

　村正の刀は漂ってきた木の葉を斬り。
　正宗の刀は木の葉を斬らずに逃した。

　――刃は斬るべきを斬り斬らぬべきは斬らぬが最上。
　師はそう云い、村正ではなく正宗を賞賛した。

　…………だが。
　
　武器、刃というものの本質を正しく<ruby>顕<rt>あらわ</rt></ruby>していたのは、
果たしてどちらであったのだろう。

en.html:
Hikaru"...Kageaki..."
Kageaki"..."
Hikaru"Right now I have no business with you. Go."
Kageaki"That will not be possible."
Hikaru"..."
Kageaki"Yamato has had enough of this nightmare called Silver Star. Tonight... I will be bringing the curtain down."
Hikaru"...Oh...?"
Muramasa《—》
Muramasa II《—》
Hikaru"That mad dog of yours. Not here with you?"
Kageaki"I left her behind."
Hikaru"Why?"
Kageaki"Because it is the same thing. My hands bring you down, or her hands do it. Same thing."
Hikaru"..."
Kageaki"You were right, Silver Star. The Balance of Good and Evil is the fate that martial force carries."
Kageaki"Whichever way I go, no escape from it."
Hikaru"............Heh."

en.html:
Hikaru"Heh heh heh... Ha ha ha ha ha ha!"
Kageaki"..."
Hikaru"Haan... now this is correct. Awake at last, Kageaki! That delusion is finished!"
Kageaki"Yes."
Hikaru"Then come, let us play. Dear Kageaki, with these fingers I will guide you. Such loving care I will take..."
Hikaru"To the utmost height of martial force! Its highest reach! Slaughter everyone under heaven, win completely against the world, and ascend the throne of godhood!!"
Kageaki"There, I am not going. You also, I will not allow."
Kageaki"My delusion, you cut through. Yours, I will cut through. This rotten, blood-red dream ends here. Silver Star—"
Kageaki"No more climbing to heaven. Today, here, I bring you down to earth!!"
Hikaru"Now you roar, Kageaki! You swear to cut off my path?"
Hikaru"Then no holding back. No family discount. Hikaru, called the silver star—her power in its purest form, that is what you will see—"
Hikaru"Hold tightly to your life! No tumbling down into the land of the dead!!"

ja.html:
光「ふふふ……ははははははは！」
景明「……」
光「そう……それでいい。 　妄念から醒めたようだな、景明！」
景明「ああ」
光「では戯れ合おう。 　可愛い景明、この指で慈しみながら誘いざなって やるぞ……」
光「武の極みへ！　高き果てへ！ 　天下万民を鏖みなごろし、世界への完全勝利を以て、 至高かみの座へ登らん!!」
景明「そんなところへは行かぬ。 　行かせもせぬ」
景明「俺の妄念はお前が断った。お前の妄念は俺 が断つ。血の色に腐った夢はここで終わりだ。 　銀星号――」
景明「お前はもう天へ昇らない。 　今日ここで、俺がお前を地へ墜とす!!」
光「吼えたな、景明！ 　我が道を断つと誓うか！」
光「ならば手心は加えまい。 　白銀の星と呼ばれし光の能力ちから、その精粋を 見せてくれる――」
光「冥府へ転げ落ちぬよう、命をしかと掴んで おけ!!」
